title: Compact Metric Persona Switcher — accessible, localized microinteractions
creator: Asha Patel
description: Design and validate a compact persona/metric switcher used in dense dashboard rows (cost explorer + route-level rollouts). The component must preserve a compact visual footprint while meeting WCAG 2.1 AA keyboard/contrast/voiceover requirements and supporting localization (LTR/RTL, expanded translations, locale-specific numeric formatting). This ticket covers prototype finalization, accessibility review, and engineering handoff artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard: complete tab sequence and arrow-key switching; visible focus ring that meets WCAG contrast in both light and dark themes
Screen reader: persona labels announced with role=tab and aria-selected state; concise helper text read for multi-action items
Contrast: all text and interactive elements meet WCAG AA against the active background token in both high density and compact density variants
Localization: labels can expand by up to 40% without overlap; RTL reversal properly mirrors layout and focus order
Touch targets: interactive hit area >= 44px for touch, achieved without increasing perceived density (use invisible padding technique)
Handoff: Figma tokens, CSS variables, and Storybook stories (including a11y addon snapshots) provided; engineering ✅ to implement keyboard tests and a11y e2e checks
accessibility_notes: Use focus-visible polyfill and rely on CSS: focus-outline is a 3px solid token with accessible contrast; fallback for browsers without :focus-visible
Provide live region announcements for persona changes when used in filter contexts (aria-live polite)
Avoid relying solely on color to indicate selection; include shape/icon + text state
Test with VoiceOver (macOS), NVDA (Windows), TalkBack (Android). Preliminary tests passed on VoiceOver with minor label verbosity issues.
localization_notes: Reserve 40% extra width for label expansion; use the expanded-label token in Figma to simulate long translations
Numeric compacting: use locale-aware short number formatting (e.g., 1.2M vs 1,2M) and mirror direction in RTL locales
Microcopy: provide a translation key table and note for translators when label + badge appear together to avoid concatenation errors
visual_changes: Compact density variant reduces vertical padding by 40% but preserves minimum touch targets via invisible hit area
Introduce high-contrast token pair for selected-state background + foreground to meet AA in both themes
Animated selection underline reduced to reduced-motion-safe transform with 150ms duration and prefers-reduced-motion support
comments: 2026-03-01 — Asha P: Initial spike complete. Created compact & standard density variants. Identified potential touch-target vs density trade-off.
2026-03-03 — Liam O: Prototype uploaded to Figma. Ran internal keyboard pass; arrow left/right navigation works but focus ring clipped in compact rows. Suggested invisible padding approach.

2026-03-04 — Accessibility review (Maya S): Contrast on active label fails on dark-high-contrast with 12px type. Recommendation: bump selected-foreground token and add icon state for non-color affordance.

2026-03-05 — Localization lead (Hiro T): Noted several Japanese and German translations exceed current token width in the prototype. Recommended 30-40% expansion test and fallback truncation rules with tooltip.

2026-03-06 — Design decision: adopt invisible hit area to preserve 44px touch target without increasing perceived density. Add explicit aria-labels for badges that carry counts to avoid verbose screen reader reads.

2026-03-07 — Prototype usability test: 3 participants (screen reader users); all successfully navigated via keyboard and voiceover announcements were acceptable after adjusting labels. One participant suggested stronger audible cue when switching personas in a dynamic filter — added aria-live polite on container.
2026-03-08 — Engineering sync (ENG-3142): Agreed on CSS vars, tokens mapping, and Storybook knobs. Eng will add Cypress keyboard scenarios and Playwright voiceover smoke test.

2026-03-09 — PM review (PM-1280): Confirmed this should ship with console-2026.03 release as an accessibility-improving iteration for the cost explorer rollouts route. Minor scope change accepted: postpone micro-animations until after release to reduce risk.
2026-03-10 — Asha P: Updated Figma with RTL mirror, expanded label samples, and added a reduced-motion variant. Preparing final handoff package and accessibility checklist for engineering.
